_comment: Languages for every sheet. The first entry is the main language: it is written first, lives at the plain paths (<base>.md, reports/<base>/) and is the site's home page. Every other entry is a translation of the same sheet with the same photo strips, written to <base>.<code>.md and published at reports/<base>/<code>/. To add a language, add an entry here; to pause one, set "enabled": false.

languages.name: 简体中文
languages.translation_notes: Simplified Chinese for kids and families. Natural, warm spoken Mandarin, not textbook prose. Keep Chinese names already in the English text as they are; give other proper names in their usual Chinese form.

languages.name: Español
languages.translation_notes: Latin American Spanish (neutral, as used across Mexico and South America): ustedes not vosotros, everyday vocabulary, friendly tone.

languages.name: 한국어
languages.translation_notes: Korean in a friendly, conversational 해요체 tone suitable for kids. Keep Chinese characters that the English text shows (with pinyin) and add the Korean reading only if it helps.

languages.name: Français
languages.translation_notes: Standard French in a warm, conversational tone for kids, using tu when speaking to the reader. Follow French typography: a space before ; : ! ? and around « guillemets », a comma as the decimal mark, and a space as the thousands separator (3 000).
